description: Prepare an UNSIGNED EVM NFT mint. Discovers the collection's mint entrypoint from deployed bytecode (ERC-721 does not standardize minting), encodes calldata, prices a competitive EIP-1559 bid from fee-history percentiles, enforces gas-war caps, and reports contract risk. Returns wallet-signable calldata — never signs or broadcasts. Supply gasLimit plus maxTotalGasWei to enforce the caps; without them the artifact is returned with a loud warning.

minter.description: Address that will sign and receive.

signature.description: Force a specific mint signature when several exist.

name: nft_mint_prepare
